# Paul Irving

## Overview

- **Age:** 16  <sub>[v3 c40 P2](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0002)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027)</sub>
- **Origin:** Boston, States  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>
- **Role:** pupil  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>

## Appearance

Paul has beautiful, dark blue eyes and delicate features. Though once small for his age, he grew very tall for his years. His once chestnut-colored curls eventually gave place to close-cropped brown locks.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c15 P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011), [v3 c23 P6](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0006), [v3 c40 P2](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0002)_

## Personality

Paul is an imaginative, sensitive, and uncommon child considered a genius by his teacher Anne. He possesses flashes of uncanny insight and a sober, meditative disposition, while remaining manly, cleanly, and well-behaved. Though polite and fair-minded, he is passionate in defense of his ideas and country.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c8 P32](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0032), [v2 c8 P52](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0052), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c23 P36](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0036), [v2 c27 P54](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0054), [v2 c27 P62](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0062)_

## History

Paul Irving moved from Boston to Avonlea to reside with his grandmother, becoming a student under Anne Shirley at Avonlea school. He and Anne quickly became kindred spirits and fast friends. Paul engaged in a drawn battle with St. Clair Donnell over their respective national flags and accidentally fell into a spring while demonstrating that his hair was naturally curly to his crush, Gracie Andrews. His father, Stephen Irving, later surprised him with a visit, during which Stephen reunited with his former love, Lavendar Lewis. After Stephen and Lavendar married, Paul moved with them to Boston, referring to Lavendar as 'Mother Lavendar'. Over the years, Paul grew up, developed an interest in football, and maintained his close bond with Anne.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c27 P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 c28 P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 c29 P1](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0001), [v3 c7 P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048), [v3 c23 P4](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0004), [v3 c40 P2](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0002)_

## Quotes

> Please, teacher, I found these in Mr. Wright’s field, and I came back to give them to you because I thought you were the kind of lady that would like them, and because . . . I like you, teacher.  <sub>[v2 c5 P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)</sub>

> Grandma says father was brought up on porridge, and it certainly did work well in his case, for you ought to see the shoulders he has. But sometimes, I really think porridge will be the death of me.  <sub>[v2 c15 P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011)</sub>

> I’m going to need all my strength of mind to bear up against this, Grandma, and I won’t have any left to grapple with porridge. Oh Grandma, I don’t know what I’ll do when my beautiful teacher goes away.  <sub>[v2 c26 P35](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0035)</sub>

> That’s the beauty of dream-people . . . they stay any age you want them.  <sub>[v2 c27 P62](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0062)</sub>

> But I call her ‘Mother Lavendar’ and I love her next best to father. I—I even love her a little better than you, teacher.  <sub>[v3 c23 P4](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0004)</sub>
